endpoint_contract: Output timestamps are strictly before the last input timestamp; one input frame produces zero output frames. Audit supports up to and including 65,536 frames and rejects 65,537.
runner: Full-output oracle decodes and finite-checks every sample, verifies exact frame count, and compares every channel sample. A small native fork/execvp/wait4 wrapper relays candidate stdout/stderr and records ru_maxrss for the exact child process; no Python RSS floor or application-reported memory is used. Default interpolation is explicitly FP32 with integer-rational phase; audit remains FP64.
